dct_title_s: Nepal Landslide: Damage Proxy Map, Jun 2021
dct_description_sm: # ARIA-SG Damage Proxy Map: Nepal, Landslide, 20 Jun 2021, v0.4 Derived from synthetic aperture radar data acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellites operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) before (8 Jun) and after (20 Jun) the event. Analysed by the ARIA-SG team at the Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) in collaboration with NASA-JPL and Caltech. **More map details and files:** Due to steep topography of this area, parts of the map may be subject to slight shift in location or being in radar shadow (i.e. not visible). **More map details and files:**
